frase_gancho.texto: Here, the seed becomes a village.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The age of the hunters ends, and the age of neighbors begins. The seed that closed the previous hall has already sprouted: now there are houses of mud and straw, cornfields, dogs, ceramics, and festivals. Over more than two thousand years, from 2500 BC to the first centuries of our era, the villages of the Central Highlands grow into towns and, in the end, into the valley’s first great city. You will see the cemetery-village of Tlatilco, the distant echoes of the Olmec, and the model of Cuicuilco, buried by a volcano. Among figurines of women, water animals, and ancient gods, the prologue to everything that follows is written here.
